Our cat knocked a glass of water onto the router last night and now the wifi drops every twenty minutes or so. I've unplugged it, dried it out, plugged it back in, and it mostly works, but "mostly" is doing a lot of lifting in that sentence.

I ordered a replacement. It ships Thursday, apparently, though the tracking page just says "label created" which never means anything useful.

In the meantime I'm tethering off my phone, which is fine for email but miserable for anything with video. The cat, for the record, shows no remorse.
